title: Show a model your old code and it writes your old bugs: 32 runs, 0% reuse
why_read: A rigorous small experiment showing that LLM code generation directly mirrors the quality and bugs of existing code in the repo is a concrete, actionable insight for anyone using AI coding tools.
analysis: The author ran 32 trials asking models to implement the same feature against two versions of their own repository, one before and one after a refactor that removed duplicated buggy code. Every run against the pre-refactor commit reproduced the same bugs the human refactor had fixed, while every run against the post-refactor commit correctly reused the clean shared component. This is a well-designed natural experiment demonstrating that code-context quality strongly and consistently determines AI-generated code quality, a finding with direct practical implications for teams relying on AI pair programming.
